privateVars.name: prisma
privateVars.description: Database service for TV show lookups

privateVars.name: tvRepository
privateVars.description: Repository used to read, write, and map TV show records

privateVars.name: tvQueueService
privateVars.description: Queue service used to schedule TV sync jobs

privateVars.name: token
privateVars.description: Cached auth token for TheTVDB API

functions.name: setTheTvDbToken
functions.description: Authenticates with TheTVDB API v4 and stores the bearer token

functions.name: search
functions.description: Searches TheTVDB for TV series by name and maps the response to SearchMedia items. Retries authentication if token is expired.

functions.name: getTv
functions.description: Gets TV show data from cache/database when fresh enough, otherwise fetches from TheTVDB and queues a sync job

functions.name: fetchFromTvdb
functions.description: Fetches extended TV show data from TheTVDB API including series details, English translations, episodes, seasons, artworks, characters, companies, and trailers

functions.name: ensureTv
functions.description: Ensures a TV show record exists in the repository. If missing or incomplete, fetches full details from TheTVDB and upserts. Falls back to a skeleton record if the fetch fails.
